The Devo's Map Doctor in your browser: the same program as the download for Windows and Linux, run here. It opens protected Warcraft III maps, fixes what stops them on Reforged 3.0, prepares them for the World Editor and ports the maps of the KK and M16 platforms. It also checks whether a map runs on Reforged or on an older game, adds cheat packs and quality of life edits, exports and imports translations, shows the files of a map (with a 3D preview of its models) and its script, and helps find out why a map fails in the game (Diagnose). The page is in English and 16 other languages.
